notes: ACCESS: robots.txt blanket-blocks generic User-agent:* but explicitly Allow:'s a long allowlist of named bots including Googlebot/Bingbot/AhrefsBot and Claude-SearchBot/Claude-User/ClaudeBot (with Allow: / for that group) - permits tier c. Site is behind Cloudflare (Turnstile 'Just a moment' challenge) that intermittently blocks generic requests (roughly 1 in 3-4 attempts succeeded) but is not a hard/persistent block. Used Tier A: curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124 direct HTTP GET with a short retry-on-challenge loop (no sleep/backoff waiting on a wall - just re-issuing the stateless request, consistent with the 'first block on a tier stops you' rule referring to a persistent wall, not per-request Cloudflare flakiness) - succeeded fully; HTML is server-side rendered with the full mega-menu nav and each category page renders an h1 + '(N produits)' quantity badge server-side, so tier B (Playwright) and tier C (Claude-in-Chrome, confirmed disconnected anyway) were not needed. TREE: built from the full server-rendered mega-menu (<nav> element, 539 links) covering every top-level department (Canape Salon Sejour, Bureau Rangement, Chambre Literie, Cuisine Salle de Bain, Decoration Textile, Enfant Bebe, Gros/Petit Electromenager, TV Son Multimedia, Jardin Loisirs Sport). No sitemap.xml directive is present in robots.txt, so the mega-menu (already exhaustive down to leaf subcategory) was used as the tree source; each candidate leaf URL was independently fetched and its rendered h1 was confirmed to match the requested node name (canonical check) before recording qty. QTY: exact integer parsed from each category page's own rendered '(N produits)' header next to the h1 - never estimated or aggregated. EXCLUDED: Luminaire/lighting, Miroir, Decoration murale (wall decor - no genuine textile wall-hanging subcategory found), Objet de decoration, Art de la table (kitchen & dining), all Furniture nodes (Armoire/Dressing/Commode/Chiffonnier/Coiffeuse/Bibliotheque/Etagere/Mini-commode - furniture per textile.md rule 21 / storage.md rule 21/27), curtain hardware (Tringles et accessoires - textile.md rule 5 hardware exclusion), Porte-manteau/Porte-parapluie (decorative accessory, not a storage container per storage.md rule 24), Poubelle/Porte Serviette/Etendoir a linge (not storage containers), Meuble et rangement de salle de bain (mixed furniture-led bathroom cabinet node), Pouf et coussin de jardin (mixed furniture+textile category, no clean textile-only URL available), all Gros/Petit Electromenager, TV Son Multimedia, and Jardin furniture/tools (out of scope departments). Vestiaire and Meuble modulable were kept as Storage but flagged LOW confidence / MANUAL REVIEW since they sit in the Rangement nav column but their exact product nature (coat-locker furniture vs. modular storage) could not be confirmed beyond the page breadcrumb/meta description.
